definitions.explanation: A small wingless insect that lives on the skin and hair of people or animals and feeds on blood. Head lice ({頭|あたま}ジラミ) still spread among small children at nurseries and schools in Japan.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧シラミがいた。
examples.english: My child had lice in their hair.

examples.japanese: ⟦{保育園|ほいくえん}→保育園：04704_hoikuen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧シラミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|はや}って→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧、⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}した→駆除する：21319_kujosuru⟧。
examples.english: Lice were going around at the nursery, so we got rid of them with a special shampoo.

notes:
WRITING: Usually written in katakana. The kanji {虱|しらみ} is rare outside older texts. In compounds the initial し becomes じ: ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧ジラミ (head louse), {毛|け}ジラミ (crab louse).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- シラミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わく: lice breed, an infestation appears
- シラミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}する→駆除する：21319_kujosuru⟧: to get rid of lice
- シラミつぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: one by one, leaving nothing out (literally, crushing lice one at a time), as in シラミつぶし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧: to search every corner

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ノミ→ノミ：32664_nomi⟧: flea
- ⟦ダニ→ダニ：32586_dani⟧: mite, tick
